settings.cv: three folds, stratified shuffled for random; same label-independent group allocator with equal thirds for scaffold
settings.infeasible: raise if any partition or any CV training/validation fold lacks a class; never retry seeds or move groups based on labels
settings.scaffold_assignment: sort groups by decreasing size times seeded uniform[0.5,1.5] priority; assign each to largest remaining absolute target capacity; ties partition order
